slides.title: CareThread
slides.subtitle:
Clinical handoffs with
responsibility intact
slides.notes: CareThread is a browser-based clinical communication simulation for the AssemblyAI hackathon. The visual style does not imply Apple sponsorship, Apple integration or a native Apple application. Synthetic data only. No clinical efficacy claim.

slides.title: Uncertainty can disappear in a handoff
slides.left:
The scan result is pending.
Discharge is waiting
for the review.
slides.right:
The scan was clear.
The patient is ready
for discharge.
slides.footer: Fictional example. Clinicians determine what is correct.
slides.notes: This is a fictional communication example, not a treatment recommendation. AHRQ TeamSTEPPS handoff guidance motivates retaining uncertainty, contingencies and acknowledged responsibility. It does not validate this software. Sources: https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/tools/handoff.html and https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/tools/checkback.html

slides.title: A shared view of unfinished work
slides.subtitle: The task keeps its owner, timing and source statement.
slides.notes: React/Remotion illustration based on the implemented CareThread UI. It represents a synthetic handoff whose states were verified in the app. It is not a screenshot or live recording. Source statements, roles, revisions and unknown required fields remain reviewable.

slides.title: Acceptance and completion are separate
slides.left_detail:
The receiver acknowledges
the current revision.
slides.right_detail:
Completion requires a separate
participant report.
slides.footer: A substantive correction clears acceptance of the earlier revision.
slides.notes: This distinction is implemented in the deterministic state engine. Acknowledgment is not clinical completion. The prototype records participant-reported completion and cannot independently observe physical care. Optional real accepted-state screenshot may replace the native comparison if it supports the final UI design.

slides.footer: Server-held key. Temporary voice tokens. Browser records stay on this device.
slides.notes: AssemblyAI managed Voice Agent handles speech and replies with tools: []. Each final participant transcript goes through the server-side AssemblyAI LLM Gateway using qwen3.5-4b-32k-fast. The planner proposes JSON actions; deterministic validation checks sources, role, fields and revisions before application. Audio and text are processed by AssemblyAI. IndexedDB stores synthetic records in the same browser. Sources: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/browser-integration and https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/quickstart. Implementation sources: lib/voice-config.ts, lib/voice-tools.ts and app/api/analyze/route.ts.

slides.title: Built for handoff practice
slides.body:
Review omissions and clarifications
after a handoff exercise.

An institution subscription is
a business hypothesis to test.
slides.footer: Next step: clinician feedback and a measured usability study.
slides.notes: Clinical educators and simulation centers are the initial customer hypothesis, not existing customers. No market-size, revenue, customer-demand or outcome claim. Usability research should measure understanding, missed issues, false alerts and added time. Clinical deployment needs work beyond this prototype.

slides.title: What we verified
slides.fixture_detail: Speech to a validated pending task
slides.footer: Browser microphone-device behavior and clinical efficacy remain unvalidated.
slides.notes: Implementation lead reported 80 passing checks: 78 domain/API checks and two voice lifecycle regressions (late events after reset, role change during analysis). Production build passed after the visual redesign and Vercel deployment is ready. Public synthetic-fixture evidence: docs/evaluation/synthetic-voice-result.json in https://github.com/ajegz/carethread. One generated audio fixture correctly preserved a task, owner, time, condition and pending uncertainty as an unreviewed item, followed by a spoken review request. Three separate Gateway cases covered capture, confirmation and acknowledgment; a rate-limited request passed after a spaced retry. Neither the software count nor the single fixture establishes clinical reliability. No latency benchmark or success percentage is claimed.
